$comment: Reference schema for content/dsa/*.json. Every topic file is one object of this shape. Field notes are in _README.md.
slug: string, url-safe topic id, matches filename
title: string
subtitle: string | null
author: string | null
targets: optional array of companies the source doc named
overview: markdown string, the Pattern Overview prose
coreConcept: markdown string | null, the mental-model section

triggerWords: phrases that appear in problem statements

variations.id: url-safe id, unique within the topic
variations.name: string

boxes.type: observations | intuition | tricks | keywords | warning | summary | note
boxes.title: string | null, only when the source used a custom title
boxes.body: markdown string, used instead of items when the box was prose

problems.title: string
problems.platformId: string | null, LeetCode number where known
problems.urlVerified: boolean, false means the url is a search fallback or unconfirmed

notes: conversion notes: source errors corrected, content that could not be recovered
